scenarios.name: Show the Front label without a diagonal stroke across the orientation face

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
the viewport orientation control displays the Front view
the user inspects the visible orientation face
the square face is labeled FRONT in uppercase
no diagonal stroke crosses the face
the block and model browser remain visible

scenarios.name: Rotate and restore a face-on view

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
the orientation control displays Front with its label upright
the block's front face is wider than it is tall on screen
the user selects the upper curved rotation arrow on the orientation control
the control still displays Front with its label rotated by a quarter turn
the block's front face is taller than it is wide on screen
the user selects the other curved rotation arrow
the Front label is upright again
the block's front face is wider than it is tall again
the same part and model browser remain active

scenarios.name: Choose a corner from a face-on view

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
the orientation control displays an upright Front view
the user selects the upper-right corner of the orientation control
the block is displayed obliquely with its top, front and right faces visible
the orientation control shows the Top, Front and Right faces
the same part and model browser remain active

scenarios.name: Retain hybrid projection when selecting a named face

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
it is displayed obliquely in Orthographic projection
the user chooses Perspective with Ortho Faces from the orientation control menu
the block remains visible in an oblique view with a changed projection
the user selects Top on the orientation control
the block is displayed face-on from the top
the orientation control displays Top
the user reopens the orientation control menu
Perspective with Ortho Faces is marked as the current mode
the user chooses Orthographic
the same part remains active in the top view

scenarios.name: Toggle orientation lock for a selected face

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
no model geometry is selected
the user opens the orientation control context menu
Lock to Current Selection is unavailable
the user closes the menu and selects a visible face of the block
the user opens the orientation control context menu
Lock to Current Selection is available
the user chooses Lock to Current Selection
a lock indicator appears beside the orientation control
the user reopens the orientation control context menu
Lock to Current Selection is checked
the user chooses Lock to Current Selection again
the lock indicator disappears
the user clears the face selection and reopens the orientation control context menu
Lock to Current Selection is unavailable
